svg.text: Does Λ join as a second dial? At large N yes, as a second circle op; with graviton loops, no
In u = 1/g and v = λ/g: two separate circle-op flows,
rates d − 2 = 2 (G's units) and d = 4 (vacuum energy's units).
Real exponents (2, −2) at the Gaussian point, a complex pair at the UV point:
no projective (two-coupled-circle-op) flow can do both (checks L3, L5).
Known: the large-N exponents {4, 2} and λ* = 3/8 (Donà–Eichhorn–Percacci 2013, Table II); the EH spiral (Reuter 1998; Litim 2004).
Ours: the decoupled circle ops in (1/g, λ/g) with rates d − 2 and d (L1, L4); the no-go for the pure-gravity flow (L5). Purple: flows into the UV point; gray: away from it.
